items.title: The Market That Moved

question.text: The wholesale fish market moved away. Why is Tsukiji still full of food?

choices.response: Yes. The stalls for visitors stayed.
The big auction left. Look at who stayed.

choices.text: Everything was rebuilt as a theme park
choices.response: It is still a working food street.

items.notes: Confirm Outer Market vs Toyosu wording before live.

items.title: You Are Standing in the Sea
items.hook: A few centuries ago, this was not land.

question.text: What does the name Tsukiji refer to?

choices.response: Fish is why people come. The name is about the ground.
Yes. The name points to land that was made.
Temples matter in Tokyo. This name is about fill.
It sits by the bay. Check the name itself.

items.reveal: This ground was taken from the bay after a huge fire in Edo.

moreInfo.title: Filled land
moreInfo.text: After a great fire in the 1600s, new land was packed into the bay here. Confirm the 1657 date and the reading of Tsukiji before this is live.

items.notes: Confirm Tsukiji as reclaimed land. Do not invent fill dates.
